record.dic_text:
07294 Rahab {rah'-hab}

同 07293; 陽性名詞

欽定本 - Rahab 3; 3

拉哈伯 = "大水"
1) 暴風, 傲慢自大 (只用作名字)
   1a) 神話中的海怪
   1b) 代表埃及的象徵

07294 Rahab {rah'-hab}

the same as 07293;; n m

AV - Rahab 3; 3

Rahab = "breadth"
1) storm, arrogance (but only as names)
   1a) mythical sea monster
   1b) emblematic name of Egypt
